intelligence.essence: A Smart Note is a single idea, story, observation, or insight, turned into its clearest possible form — a beautifully presented, structured piece of intelligence that anyone can understand in seconds. It's how knowledge gets shared, organized, and preserved on NayaNET.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you learn something amazing — like how to make the fluffiest pancakes — and you write it on a beautiful card, with pictures, so anyone who reads it can make them too. That's a Smart Note: your best idea, written so clearly that anyone can use it.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine writing down your best recipe on a beautiful card — clear enough that your grandchild can follow it, pretty enough to keep forever, and shared with the whole family so nobody ever loses it. That's a Smart Note: knowledge, kept and shared in its best form.
